notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
[b][h3]🍬 Hey Players! 🍬[/h3][/b]

We’ve just rolled out a new update for Candy Shop Simulator and we’ve packed in some tweaks, fixes and cool new tools to make your candy–making life easier (and tastier 😋). Here’s what’s new:

[u][b]✨ Patch Notes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Slight optimization improvements for smoother gameplay
[*] Improved 3rd person camera – now placed more to the side so it won’t block your view
[*] Added a crosshair for better precision
[*] Added new help tips to guide you along the way
[*] Fixed the serving plate (no more funky behavior there 🍽️)
[*] Introduced the Duplicator – it can duplicate your creations (not only the final ones!)
[*] Added an Advanced Mixer that automatically pulls ingredients straight from your pantry 🥣
[*] Product prices are now calculated based on the ingredients you used
[*] Looking at a shelf or product display now shows you the quantity available
[*] Cooling & baking times reduced to just 5 seconds ⏱️
[*] Hand mixer now works without you having to stir manually 🎉
[/list]

We hope these changes make your candy shop a smoother, sweeter experience. Thanks for all your feedback! It really helps us shape the game! 💌

See you soon,
Candy Shop Simulator Team 🍬

notes.title: Take Your Sweet Time!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey everyone! 👋[/b][/h1]

I know you are hungry for some sweets, and we deliver! 🛵
In this devlog we're gonna be talking about something completely new and exciting!
Candy Shop Simulator is not only a game about making beautiful and tasty creations, but also about running a business. So here we go with another mechanic! 🎂

[h3]Order System[/h3]
After reaching a certain level of your shop, you will unlock the Order mechanic.
Through your phone  you will be able to see specific cake orders made by interested customers, which you can accept or deny! 📱
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/f3b7b98b5ed77bfef821ed6d3c304e347eb0d3eb.png[/img]

After accepting the order, you will have to make the cake according to the specific layers, toppings and decorations, and then deliver it to the client on your bicycle! If you fail, you lose reputation and money. 🚲
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/bccd2ebec1321843aa6d90146588f82bec8421ef.png[/img]

I know, a time limit sounds terrifying, but you can ease up. It isn't anything close to a speed race, you will have enough time to plan the cake, and even go out to buy the ingredients for it. Some of the requests may be very specific, we don't require you to have everything in the stock right away! 🕰️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/d8b23e4cd5351df7bf711aff00c88791ac75fd15.png[/img]

[h3][b]Why do the orders in the first place?[/b][/h3]
[list]
[h3][b][*] It brings more money than average sales in your shop! 
[*] New exciting challenges with time management!
[*] You can feel like a true confectioner with a mission!
[*] It will require of you much more flexibility and moving around then just sitting at the shop all day long![/b][/h3]
[/list]

[h3][b]Freedom of creation![[/b]/h3]
I understand that orders may sound a bit too restrictive. But that is not true at all. You can choose the style of decorations and how you make it, the order you put on the ingredients is up to you.
Orders aren't here to restrict, but to give you a push towards a certain objective. How you reach it is up to you! 😍

Our team had some fun with their own cake creation, showing off what can be done in Candy Shop Simulator. Check out their orders! 👇
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/bca8c8fa1d849bd4755881b4959e3177a1a4c34b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/d09f3b8f50fffa326f3cc4e6cdd00980ba3a528a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/61c49544a342708577407ba9ad02e40f7345ccbc.png[/img]

That is it for now, I hope you are excited as much as we are about creating some cakes! If you want to share your feedback, thoughts, crazy sweet ideas, feel free to join our Discord server! 💬
[url=https://discord.gg/3MhHsgxXfd][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/6338a0ceb937b950614e717143ae674efd0a8c59.png[/img][/url]

See you soon!
Candy Shop Simulator Team

notes.title: Additional Furniture
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Candymakers! 🍬[/b][/h1]

We’re excited to introduce new gameplay features to make your Candy Shop Simulator experience even sweeter! Get ready for more interaction, fun and challenges as you manage your candy shop. 💪

We’ve decided to add additional features to make your candy shop management experience more engaging. Now, when customers purchase a cake in your shop, they will either leave or (if the player buys and places tables) sit at the tables and enjoy their dessert. Having customers eat at your tables will always give a positive boost to your shop's overall rating. 😋

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/9cd29a79d503b8652b344a34d174d04651ba18f1.png[/img]
[h3]Cleaning and Customer Satisfaction 🧼[/h3]
Customers in your shop aren’t the cleanest, and they won’t clean up after themselves. Therefore, you or an employed staff member will need to clean up the tables by clicking on them. If there are dirty plates on a table, customers won’t sit at it, so keeping your tables tidy is crucial for maintaining a steady flow of customers. 🧹

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/8cbdc0a2334fb5508e714a1224eb6430071aa6a3.png[/img]
[h3]Customization Options for Your Shop 🎨[/h3]
In addition to the gameplay changes, we’ve also added a customization feature! You can paint tables, tablecloths, and chairs separately, allowing you to create a truly personalized and visually appealing space for your customers. 🌈

Get ready to manage your candy shop with even more going on and if you’d like to stay on top of any upcoming news don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist and join our discord to get notified about any updates! 👍

[url=https://discord.gg/3MhHsgxXfd][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/6338a0ceb937b950614e717143ae674efd0a8c59.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2811530/Candy_Shop_Simulator/

See you soon
Candy Shop Simulator Team

notes.title: Character Customization
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Candy Makers! 👋[/b][/h1]

Welcome back to devlog#2 of 🍬 Candy Shop Simulator! Today we’ve prepared a cool feature for you to check out! 

In our game there’ll be an option to customize your character. It’s not going to be anything complex but you’ll get to make choices on the following elements:

[list][b]- gender
- skin color
- eye color
- head shape
- hair
- clothes[/b][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/1ecdf75a870f30cd3a5a03b8f83daab204e31f75.png[/img]

On top of that, we do understand that the looks can get boring and you might want to mix things up a little. That’s why we’ve introduced ways to change your appearance during the gameplay! 🤩 With the help of shops in your city (That you can visit with the previously mentioned bike 🚲) you can change your character to some degree.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/50865ec948488aaa477b4957293e73ae1e51140f.png[/img]
These shops are[b] the hairdresser and the clothing store[/b]. 👕 Although you can’t change your eye color or the shape of your head, it is only natural to change your style once in a while, isn’t it?

[b]What would you like us to talk about in the next devlog? 🤔[/b] Let us know in the comments! Thank you for joining us today. If you enjoyed the devlog consider joining our discord and adding the game to your wishlist to get notified about the upcoming news!

notes.title: 🍭 Welcome to the Candy Shop 🍭
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Candy Lovers! 🍬[/b][/h1]

[h3]Welcome to the first devlog from most likely the most sugar-packed game on Steam! 🤤 We’re happy to see you’re interested in our game and today we’d like to outline the ideas for the gameplay. As you may have guessed, it is another game in the “Pet Shop” universe! ❤️ If you’re not familiar with the title, you may want to check it out in the link below! 👇[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2401680/Pet_Shop_Simulator/ 
As the name suggests, you’ll become an owner of your own candy shop! 🍭 [b]Your assortment will consist of both sweets ordered from other producers and the ones you’ll produce[/b]. We’re sure you’ll be interested in hearing more about this mechanic that’s why we’ll create a separate devlog all about making sweets! 🍫

You’ll also get to experience other everyday activities necessary for smooth operation of your store- selling products at checkout, restocking the shelves etc. 

We’ll also introduce a [b]bike delivery mechanic[/b]. 🚲 You’ll be able to deliver the sweets from your shop to your customers’ doorsteps using a cool bike. [b]The ordered sweets will mostly consist of hand made cakes and cupcakes[/b]. 🧁 This part of the city is bike-friendly and there are almost no cars in there. (With an exception for the delivery trucks with all the necessary supplies for your store). On top of that, the bike will undoubtedly help you to arrive at many service points such as hairdresser. ✂️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/7269ed2e367201c94de4f0bc40df65efa452c804.png[/img]
[b]Be careful though, there is a deadline for delivery and missing it will make the client drop a negative review for your shop, not to mention revoking the order. 🙁[/b]

This brings us to today’s question: Would you like to be able to have some customization options for your bikes? Let us know in the comments! 💬

There’s one more interesting feature available in the game- [b]the building where your shop is placed…🔨 You’ll be the one to create it![/b] This will allow you to plan the inside of your store and adjust it so it accommodates your gameplay tactic the best! With that being said, it is another big mechanic which most definitely deserves a separate devlog so we’ll make sure to talk about it in more detail on another occasion. 💪

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868567/e1334f915289a8ec1c6a68b63a220fbf4af19caf.png[/img]
This brings us to an end of today’s devlog- we can’t wait to hear from you so make sure to drop a comment in the discussion section! [b]If you’d like to be an active part in creating our game we suggest adding the game to your wishlists on Steam[/b] so you don’t miss out on any Playtest, devlog and important notifications we’ll publish! 👍 You can also [b]join our discord community[/b] and have a chat with our crew. 🙂

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2811530/Candy_Shop_Simulator/ 

See you soon,
Candy Shop Simulator Team
